teaser.en: Its name and its main use are one and the same: *mdege* is medicine against *dege*, the evil eye.
teaser.sw: Jina lake na matumizi yake makuu ni kitu kimoja: *mdege* ni dawa dhidi ya *dege*, jicho baya.
teaser.dg: Dzinare na kaziye kulu ni chitu chimwenga: *mdege* ni dawa ya *dege* (*evil eye*).

summary.en: *Mdege* is a small resinous tree of coastal bushland and thicket with peeling bark. The Digo use it as medicine against *dege*, the evil eye.
summary.sw: *Mdege* ni mti mdogo wenye utomvu wa ubani, wa vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani, wenye gome linalobambuka. Wadigo huutumia kama dawa dhidi ya *dege*, jicho baya.
summary.dg: *Mdege* ni muhi mdide wenye utomvu, wa weruni na vitsaka vya pwani, wenye gopha rinarotuluka vipande-vipande. Adigo anauhumira dza dawa ya *dege* (*evil eye*).

about.en: *Mdege* is a small tree of the myrrh family, rich in fragrant resin. Its bark peels away in papery flakes, showing fresh, often greenish bark underneath. Like its relatives, it is likely to lose its leaves in the dry season.
about.sw: *Mdege* ni mti mdogo wa familia ya manemane, wenye utomvu mwingi wenye harufu nzuri. Gome lake hubambuka kwa vibanzi vyembamba kama karatasi, na kuonyesha gome jipya chini yake, mara nyingi la rangi ya kijani. Kama jamaa zake, huenda hupukutisha majani wakati wa kiangazi.
about.dg: *Mdege* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *myrrh*, na una utomvu wenye arufu nono kpwa unji. Gophare rinatuluka kpwa vipande vyembamba dza karatasi, na photsi kunaonekana gopha riphya, mara nyinji ra chijani. Dza nduguze, inaelekea kukala makodzage ganagbwa wakati wa kazikazi.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani vya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that *mdege* is used as medicine against *dege*, the evil eye.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba *mdege* hutumika kama dawa dhidi ya *dege*, jicho baya.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *mdege* nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya *dege* (*evil eye*).

culture.en: The tree's name comes from its use: *mdege* is the medicine against *dege*, the evil eye. It is a clear example of how Digo plant names often record what a plant is for.
culture.sw: Jina la mti huu linatokana na matumizi yake: *mdege* ni dawa dhidi ya *dege*, jicho baya. Ni mfano mzuri wa jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo mara nyingi yanavyohifadhi kazi ya mmea.
culture.dg: Dzina ra muhi rinalavywa kula kaziye: *mdege* ni dawa ya *dege*. Ni mfwano mnono wa vira madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo mara nyinji ganavyoonyesa kazi ya mmea.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mdege*. No Swahili or English name has been recorded; its scientific name is *Commiphora zanzibarica*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mdege*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Commiphora zanzibarica*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mdege*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Commiphora zanzibarica*.

reason.en: Another plant named for its use in healing
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine uliopewa jina kutokana na matumizi yake katika uganga
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina uriohewa dzina kula kpwa kaziye ya dawa
